_comment: Which fork commit pairs with this repo's state. Same pattern as wowsims.lock.json (plan decision D1). branchedFrom is the upstream commit this fork branch actually sits on -- read it as a fact about the clone, not as a restatement of wowsims.lock.json. Decision D2 intended the two to be the same, and as of 2026-08-21 they are not: the fork is on cbf6b75 (feature/backend-reforge) while the engine pin moved to v0.0.119. See ticket 251 for the open decision; do not reconcile them by editing this field. The clone at clonePath is gitignored (vendor/) and has its own .git pushing to the personal fork. pushed:false records that nothing has left this machine -- plan section 1 keeps any push behind a separate explicit ask, so flipping this flag is a deliberate act, not a side effect.
